instruction: Look at guih13_site_contours_seed.dxf in LibreCAD. Clean and complete the hard site grading drawing, deleting all GUIDE entities before saving. Draw SITE boundary through (0,0), (420,20), (395,285), and (40,300). Draw CONTOUR polylines through (25,45),(110,65),(205,58),(310,82),(390,75); through (30,105),(120,120),(230,112),(330,142),(388,130); through (45,165),(135,177),(245,170),(350,198); and through (62,230),(160,240),(275,232),(370,252). Add contour labels 102.0, 103.0, 104.0, 105.0, spot labels SPOT 103.45 and SPOT 104.80, north arrow (390,240)-(390,275), and SCALE 1:500. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih13_site_contours_completed.dxf. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step.
